note: Metric availability checked against official developer docs on the date above. UNAVAILABLE = platform API does not expose it; NOT_AUTHORIZED = needs a scope/tier/review the account lacks; NOT_APPLICABLE = metric makes no sense for this content type; NOT_READY = too soon after publish. Never coerced to 0.

platforms.official_api: YouTube Analytics API v2 + Data API v3
platforms.account_requirement: channel owner; revenue requires an active YouTube Partner Program / monetization
platforms.analytics_delay: ~48h for finalized revenue; core metrics near real-time
platforms.known_limitations: estimatedRevenue only with monetary scope + monetization; Shorts vs long-form reported separately.

platforms.official_api: TikTok Display API (own Business account content)
platforms.account_requirement: TikTok Business account; own content only
platforms.known_limitations: Watch time, retention, traffic sources, audience demographics and revenue are NOT exposed by the API for third-party integrations. Creator dashboard CSV can be imported manually (source_type=MANUAL_IMPORT).

platforms.official_api: Instagram Platform - Media Insights (Graph API v22+)
platforms.known_limitations: impressions & video_views deprecated in v22 (use 'views'). profile_views/website_clicks deprecated. No organic revenue via API. reels_skip_rate is Reels-only.

platforms.official_api: Facebook Graph API - Page / Reels insights
platforms.known_limitations: Metric NAMES differ from Instagram (post_impressions, post_video_views, blue_reels_play_count, post_video_avg_time_watched). In-stream ad revenue is a separate, limited report; treat as NOT_AUTHORIZED by default.

platforms.account_requirement: Threads account; personal accounts unlock demographics at 100 followers
platforms.known_limitations: No watch time / retention / revenue. Per-post: views, likes, replies, reposts, quotes, shares.

platforms.official_api: X API v2 - Tweet public_metrics / (organic metrics need user context + tier)
platforms.account_requirement: Paid API access (Free tier is write-only, no reads). Organic/non-public metrics need Basic+ tier.
platforms.known_limitations: Free tier cannot read. public_metrics: like/reply/repost/quote/bookmark counts; impression_count and organic metrics require a paid tier + user-context auth.

platforms.account_requirement: Pinterest account; TRIAL access is heavily rate-limited (owner only)
platforms.known_limitations: Metrics: IMPRESSION, SAVE, PIN_CLICK, OUTBOUND_CLICK, VIDEO_MRC_VIEW, VIDEO_AVG_WATCH_TIME. No revenue.

platforms.official_api: LinkedIn - Organization Share Statistics (Community Management API)
platforms.account_requirement: Organization page + Community Management API partner review; member (personal) post analytics are effectively unavailable via API
platforms.known_limitations: APP_REVIEW_REQUIRED. Personal profile post analytics are not available. Org metrics: impressionCount, clickCount, likeCount, commentCount, shareCount, engagement.
No official post-analytics API. Visitor count / dwell time / referral breakdown are only available via manual CSV export (source_type=CSV_IMPORT). Never synthesise them as API data.
